statement: Blind annotation from the Beinecke scan alone (full page, a full-resolution crop of the top row and one of the centre). Centre: a clothed person in a blue tunic and broad hat carrying a crossbow, with a short word in another script beneath. Two rings of nude standing figures without tubs, each with a star and a short label, and four more nude figures in a row outside the wheel above it. The label lines fall into groups of 4, 16 and 10, which I give to the top row (left to right, four figures counted on the scan), the outer ring and the inner ring; I did not manage a secure independent count of the ring figures on this faint drawing, so the 16 and 10 rest on the label groups. Labels assigned from line ids and unit codes only, words not read; ring labels run clockwise from the figure at the top by my assumption, so ids may be rotated by a constant within a ring. Ring figures carry generic features only. Green stains at the lower left look like offset or show-through, not drawing.

features.position: centre
features.note: the only clothed figure on the page: a person striding to the left in a blue tunic with a darker pleated skirt, blue hose, and a broad round hat with a long hanging tail, holding a crossbow pointed down to the left; a small word in a different, Latin-like script is written under the feet; no star in the centre
